name: twitter

dimensions.name: overall_assessment
dimensions.description: Given everything you know about this author, their history, the tweet content, and the context — what is your honest estimate of the probability this tweet hits 2x their median impressions? Do not think in dimensions. Think holistically. Is this tweet better or worse than their median? How much better or worse? The base rate is 28% of tweets hit. Most tweets should be 10-30%. Only genuinely standout tweets should be above 40%.

probability_guide: Output your honest probability estimate directly. No formula.
Base rate: 28% of tweets hit 2x median. Start from 28% and adjust.
If the tweet is clearly better than their median work: adjust up.
If the tweet is clearly worse: adjust down.
If you are unsure: stay near 28%.
External links reduce reach. If present, subtract 0.10.
Timing: dead zone hours (00:00-06:00 UTC) reduce by 0.10.
extra_considerations: Think about this like a prediction market. What probability would you bet on?
The author best and worst tweets are shown for reference.
Calibration: if your track record shows overconfidence, adjust down.
